description: The fault a hand-author actually makes. A misspelled `color`, or a condition path outside the closed grammar, is discarded by the reader rather than refusing the file — and a discarded entry reaches a published symbol exactly as a correct one does, so `check` would otherwise call it healthy. It is named like the ones that reach nothing, with the field pointed at the way an envelope fault is pointed at, and against the schema the carrier it sits in is held to — the overrides file's and an overlay's are two different files.

names: this entry does not validate against `nothrow.overrides.schema.json` at `color`, so the reader discarded it and it colors nothing.
this entry does not validate against `nothrow.schema.json` at `conditions.0`, so the reader discarded it and it colors nothing.
Anything it would have colored floors rather than falling through to the rung below.
